title: FSA, HSA and HRA accounts

blocks.text: These accounts all use pre-tax dollars for health costs, and HRC Total Solutions administers them.

items.label: Healthcare FSA
items.text: you choose an amount up front, the full amount is available on day one, and you pay with a VISA debit card or submit an itemized receipt.

items.label: HSA
items.text: managed through the HRC portal, with an option to sweep balances into investments at $2,000 or more.

items.label: HRA
items.text: employer-funded with the HRA OAP medical plan. It pays covered costs after you meet part of the deductible, and copays aren't reimbursed.

blocks.text: Credit card statements aren't accepted as receipts. Keep an itemized receipt with the date, item, provider and amount.
